name: Announcer of Dead Air
one_line_request: A tall hooded announcer whose face is a void of soft darkness: only two round eyes of violet phosphor and a wide mouth of flickering static-white teeth on a separate lower jaw. A deep hood of heavy black felt, frayed at the edge. Above the hood floats a broken ring of rusted antenna rods crackling with violet sparks. A collar of old microphone mesh.
archetype: Hooded voice of the station between programmes
persona_hook: It reads the station identification between programmes that were never scheduled. It speaks only in the third person, and only on the hour.
silhouette: A tall pointed hood around a dark void of a face, a broken ring floating above it and a round mesh collar below: a tall dark spire under a halo.
